title: HP Account Intelligence — Input Data Contract
description: Machine-readable contract describing what the ingestion API accepts, what each uploaded file becomes after parsing, and where that JSON is consumed. Verified against source code and reference account files on 2026-09-15. Where this file and the code disagree, the code is authoritative.

pipeline.summary: CSV/PDF file -> upload validation -> stored on disk -> file metadata document in MongoDB -> dependent extractors run -> widget JSON documents in MongoDB -> served to frontend

dataset_key.note: One of dataset_keys below. Lower-cased and trimmed before matching.

file_id_to_replace.note: Multi-file datasets only. Replaces one specific file instead of adding another.

stages.name: Validation
checks_performed: account_id is a valid ObjectId and the account exists
file extension is in that dataset's allowed_extensions
file parses: CSV via csv.reader, Excel via pandas.read_excel, PDF via PyMuPDF with page_count > 0
checks_NOT_performed: domain consistency across files is never checked
stages.consequence: A file with entirely wrong headers returns HTTP 201 Created and then produces empty widgets with no error anywhere. This is the single most important property of the current system.

stored_filename_rule.single_file_csv: Always the dataset's canonical_filename. Re-upload overwrites.
stored_filename_rule.multi_file: {dataset_key}_{unix_timestamp}_{sanitized_original_basename}{ext}, unless file_id_to_replace reuses an existing stored_filename.

stages.name: File metadata document
stages.note: Only metadata lives in MongoDB. The file bytes stay on local disk.

document_shape.category: string — duplicate of dataset_key, both are queried
document_shape.row_count: integer — data rows for CSV/Excel, PAGE COUNT for PDF
document_shape.status: one of: active | replaced | archived | deleted

stages.name: Automatic re-extraction
stages.trigger: Every feature declaring this dataset as a dependency is re-run synchronously on upload.
stages.failure_behaviour: A failing extractor never blocks the upload; the file is stored either way. Failures are returned in the response.
stages.note: Retrieval/vector index updates are queued, never run inline.

stages.name: Widget JSON documents
stages.note: This is the JSON the product actually renders. 31 widgets across 11 features.

upload_response.description: The ONLY feedback channel telling you whether a file actually worked. Always read regenerated and regeneration_failed.

regenerated: array of feature_key strings that successfully re-ran

how_to_read_it: row_count of 0 or 1 on a file you expect to be large means the parse found no rows — check the delimiter and quoting.
An empty regenerated array means no feature consumed this file. For a Group C key that is expected; for any other key it means something is wrong.
A non-empty regeneration_failed array means the file uploaded but the feature could not be rebuilt. The stored widgets are left untouched rather than overwritten with empty data.

column_matching.mechanism: csv.DictReader — header strings are dict keys
column_matching.normalization: none anywhere in the read path
column_matching.exception: hp_category_intent field-row labels are whitespace-collapsed and lower-cased before matching, so that one file is case-insensitive.

encoding.bom: permitted — files are read with utf-8-sig
encoding.fallback: hp_category_intent alone falls back to Windows-1252, where its em dash 0x97 marks an empty cell

row_scope.note: Extra rows in these files are silently ignored. One account per file.

null_sentinels.instruction: Send genuinely empty cells. Never emit these as literal text.

dates.reason: Most dates are compared and sorted as STRINGS, so any other format sorts wrong and silently produces wrong 'latest' values.

multi_value_delimiters.warning: Four different delimiters are in use. The delimiter depends on the file.

semicolon.note: Commas are converted to semicolons first, so both work

json_array_string.note: Valid JSON with double quotes, e.g. ["full_time"]. A comma-joined string becomes one bogus value.

join_key.normalization: bare lower-case host — scheme, www., path, port and trailing dot stripped
join_key.criticality: Three of the six silent failure modes are domain mismatches. Together they account for the entire intent feature.

single_file_csv.behaviour: One active file. Re-upload replaces it and the previous record is marked status=replaced.

multi_file.behaviour: Many active files coexist. Replacing one specific file requires file_id_to_replace, otherwise a new file is added.

firmographics.role: The anchor file. Feeds 9 of 11 features and supplies the account domain.

Business Description.note: No alias in two of the readers — send this exact name.

Number Of Employees Range.transform: passed through verbatim; NEVER parsed numerically; 'N/A' when blank

Yearly Revenue Range.transform: passed through verbatim; NEVER parsed numerically; 'N/A' when blank

industry_classification.rule: join non-blank values of [Linkedin Industry Category, Naics Description, Sic Code Description] with ' / ', order-preserving de-duplication

hq_location.rule: join non-blank values of [City Name, Region Name, Country Name] with ', '
hq_location.fallback: N/A, or the HQ Location column when all three are blank

notes: Revenue and employee count arrive as BANDS. No reported revenue figure exists in this file — filed financials come only from compliance_filings.

Parent Company Name.note: Empty means the company is its own parent

Full Tech Stack.note: Read LAST as the catch-all, so a technology is credited to its specific category column when present.

category_columns.note: Unusual casing — match exactly. These give a technology its provenance on screen.
casing_warnings: Testing And Qa — not 'Testing And QA'
It Security / It Management — not 'IT Security' / 'IT Management'

matching_rules.generic_column_scan: every column is scanned as a technology source, so an extra column is consumed too

known_defects.description: The current file contains 9 cells ending in '(+11 more)', '(+15 more)' etc. Nothing strips these, so '(+15 more)' is ingested as a literal technology name.
known_defects.action: Export full lists with no truncation marker.

Number Of Premium Technologies.note: Kept as a RAW STRING — never cast to a number

Money Spend On Website Technologies.note: Kept as a RAW STRING — no currency or unit parsing at all

Earliest Record.defect: Currently emitted as 2002-01-22T23:00:00 with no timezone. Please emit full ISO-8601 with Z.

open_questions.description: Cms, Ssl, Web Server, Hosting, Cdn, Framework, Analytics are documented against this dataset but absent from the delivered file.
open_questions.question: Which file carries them?

Company Website.criticality: THE most load-bearing column in the contract. If it does not normalize-match the account domain, EVERY Bombora topic is discarded and the widget reports 'No matched signal'.

Date Stamp.note: Anything else is kept raw and not guessed. If the file carries more than one distinct value, NO time window is shown at all — send one run per file.

Level Of Intent.defect: Empty throughout the current file. Needs values and a defined value set.

intent_score.role: Bombora Company Surge topic scores — the supporting-signal source.
intent_score.note: No domain column — the whole file belongs to the account.

Topic.format: 'family: detail', lower-case, e.g. 'business solutions: data insights'
Topic.note: The 'family:' prefix drives grouping — keep it. Blank means the row is skipped.

behaviours.name: non-numeric score is not zero
behaviours.rule: The topic is kept with included=false and exclusion_reason="Composite Score '<raw>' is not a number". A formatting error stays visible rather than silently scoring 0, but the topic contributes nothing.

behaviours.name: duplicate topics — first row wins
behaviours.rule: Matching is case-insensitive. Repeats are reported in duplicates_removed and NEVER averaged. De-duplicate upstream.

hp_category_intent.format: wide, TWO header rows — the only file that does not follow the one-header-row rule
hp_category_intent.encoding_note: UTF-8 preferred; falls back to Windows-1252 where em dash 0x97 marks an empty cell

structure.header_row_1: Category group names, each appearing once above the 10 columns it spans, remaining 10 cells blank
structure.header_row_2: Field names, repeated per category block
structure.data_rows: row 3 onward — one row per company per run

hp_category_intent.field_matching: case-INsensitive and whitespace-tolerant — unlike every other file

Domain.criticality: Must normalize-match firmographics.Company Domain or the WHOLE file is ignored for that account.

Run Date.rule: Several rows per domain is fine — the row with the greatest Run Date wins.

Buying Stage.rule: 'no signal' or empty means no signal; any other value with a score counts as a signal

Intent Trend.important: NOT used as a trend. With one run and no prior score there is nothing to verify it against, so it is kept as trend_label and never drawn as a direction. Supplying a prior-window score would let it become a real trend.

behaviours.name: Top HP Category is re-checked, not trusted
behaviours.rule: The system recomputes the highest-scoring category and reports whether your stated top matches. Inconsistencies surface on screen.

behaviours.name: noisy terms are flagged

terms.sla: In job postings SLA means service-level agreement, not stereolithography 3D printing
terms.identified as competitor of: A news relationship, not a print signal

behaviours.effect: The category is flagged and barred from becoming the account's primary category.

prospect_contacts.documentation_warning: Our internal feature map lists 'Full Name', 'Title', 'Department', 'Seniority', 'Linkedin Url'. NONE of those columns exist in the real file and none are read. Use the 'Prospect *' names below.

Prospect job_department_main.unmatched_behaviour: Title-Cased and still displayed, but never matches HP relevance rules

Prospect job_level_main.unmatched_behaviour: becomes 'Individual Contributor', which lowers the contact's score and can drop them off the priority list

Contact professional_email_status.note: Only the exact value 'valid' (case-insensitive) earns the data-completeness credit

Contact mobile_phone.transform: a trailing .0 from Excel float coercion is stripped, then non-digits removed; a + is emitted when the value started with one or has 10-15 digits
Contact mobile_phone.instruction: Keep this column formatted as TEXT, not number, in any Excel step

Prospect prospect_id.note: Falls back to a positional contact_N. SUPPLY IT so contact IDs stay stable across refreshes.

apollo_requested_contact.note: Presence flags the row as Apollo-sourced rather than Source A

scoring.note: Contacts are SCORED, not filtered. No row is dropped.
scoring.consequence: Missing email, phone or LinkedIn directly removes real people from the priority list.

status.critical_open_question: In the reference file this column only ever holds 'closed' (60%) or EMPTY (40%). Empty counts as OPEN, so 40% of rows become open postings purely because the field is blank — and that number drives hiring-velocity and urgency signals.
status.action_required: Confirm whether blank means open (then emit 'open' explicitly) or unknown (then we must stop counting blanks as open).

title.note: Blank means the row is skipped by several features

normalized_title.note: PREFERRED over title by content_studio and message_evaluator

first_seen_at.warning: Sorted as a STRING and truncated to 10 chars. A DD/MM/YYYY value silently produces wrong first/last dates.

seniority.note: 'junior' and 'intern' are excluded from role-proxy signals; blank becomes 'unspecified'

categories.fallback: On JSON parse failure the whole raw cell is lower-cased and used as ONE category, so a comma-joined string becomes one bogus category.

two_different_counts.warning: This file produces two different 'job count' numbers, deliberately, and they will not match.
two_different_counts.exec_hiring_velocity.data.open_job_count: len(all rows) — ignores status entirely. Despite the name it is NOT an open-only count.
two_different_counts.intent_hiring_demand.data.open_postings: rows whose status is blank, 'open' or 'active'
two_different_counts.intent_hiring_demand.data.open_postings_: the rule is published in the payload so the screen can state it

score.warning: A 0-1 scale — DIFFERENT from every other score in the system, which are 0-100.
score.transform: stored as a RAW STRING, never parsed or range-checked

id.note: A row is kept only if id OR score is present

department_onet_codes.transform: stored verbatim, never parsed; defaults to the literal string '[]'

known_defects.description: Our feature map documents a 'vendor' column. It does not exist in the file and nothing reads it. As delivered each row is a score and a date with NO technology name attached, which makes detections un-interpretable on screen.
known_defects.action: Add the technology/vendor name column, or confirm this dataset is reference-only.

google_news.role: The PRIMARY news source. news_events is the add-on.

event_headline.note: All blank means the row is skipped

event_type.defect: Mixed casing in the current file — 'launch'/'other'/'leadership' but 'M&A'. Pick one convention.

event_url.note: The ONLY URL available to either news file

relevance_confidence.warning: TEXT scale — inconsistent with news_events.confidence, which is a 0-1 float. Both feed the same widget.

source_publisher.note: A trailing ' - Publisher' suffix in the headline OVERRIDES this column when the suffix is <=40 chars, <=6 words and does not end in punctuation

article_sentence.note: All blank means the row is skipped. Blanked in output when it equals the headline.

category.note: identified_as_competitor_of is flagged as noisy — a news relationship, not a buying signal

confidence.warning: 0-1 float — inconsistent with google_news.relevance_confidence, which is High/Medium/Low text

effective_date.note: PREFERRED over found_at for the event date

news_events.known_limitation: news_events carries NO URL column and the code will never fabricate one, so these signals are unlinkable on screen.

compliance_filings.role: The only non-tabular dataset, and the ONLY source of reported financial figures. Every other file carries a band or a category.
compliance_filings.unit_of_measure: pages, not rows — row_count in the metadata holds the page count

text_layer.note: Pages are parsed from word coordinates. A page with no text layer — a scanned image — is DROPPED. Send digitally generated PDFs, not scans or photocopies.

requirements.page_count: must be > 0 or the upload is rejected
requirements.layout_support: Two-column and bilingual layouts are handled by splitting at the vertical gutter; comparative tables are reconstructed with their header row

figure_recognition.rule: A number is registered ONLY when metric + period + value + unit are all recovered together from the same page. Anything else is skipped and counted as an unbound row.

unit_requirement.rule: A scale word and a currency must appear within 60 CHARACTERS of each other on the page.
unit_requirement.consequence: A page stating no unit yields ZERO monetary claims — by design, because an unlabelled number cannot be cited.
unit_requirement.instruction: Keep the 'expressed in billions of Rupiah' sentence on EVERY page of tables, not only the first.

accepted: two or more four-digit years in 1980-2049, giving FY2025-style periods
one year plus three or more month names, giving 2026-Jul-style periods

binding.rule: Figures bind BY POSITION, never by proximity. The count of figures in a row must match the number of period columns.

compliance_filings.language_note: Indonesian-language and interleaved bilingual passages are indexed but never given a citable evidence id. English narrative is what becomes quotable.

workforce_trends.note: Deliberately excluded — holds role shares, not technologies, so it takes no part in the intent flow.

news_events_additional.note: Not consumed under this key. A file filed under category 'news_events' IS picked up.

not_consumed_notice.meaning: These keys are valid dataset_key values, so uploads succeed with HTTP 201 — but no code reads a single column from any of them. Uploading produces no widget and changes nothing on screen.
not_consumed_notice.action: Confirm which of these you intend to deliver. We will either build consumers or close the keys so an upload cannot silently do nothing.

envelope.description: Every widget document carries these fields. Only `data` differs per widget.

meaning.deterministic: Copied or composed from uploaded fields by Python. No model involved.
meaning.derived: Computed by Python — scores, bands, counts. Formula is fixed in code, never asked of a model.
meaning.inferred: Generated by an LLM from grounded inputs. Scores and figures are still computed in Python.

triggers.available: the source rows were present and produced content
triggers.empty: the dataset produced no usable rows — the screen renders a dash, never a zero
triggers.pending: an LLM widget with no OPENAI_API_KEY configured. Content is not invented; the payload carries a notice instead.

status.important: 'unverified' and 'mismatch' are NOT document statuses. They are inner values on intent_topics_table.data.account_match.status and intent_category_summary.data.category_file.status.

data.empty_convention: Most widgets set data to {} when status is 'empty'. The two intent widgets are the exception: they set status 'empty' while data still carries full provenance plus an availability/message explanation, so the screen can say WHY rather than just showing nothing.

updated_at.warning: NOT a change timestamp. It equals extracted_at on every write, because both come from one `now` in a full $set. Do not use it to detect whether content actually changed.

type_warnings.description: Fields that look numeric but are stored as STRINGS. Consumers must not assume a number.
stored_as_string: news_signals_feed.data.signals[].source_confidence — 'High' from google_news OR '0.6216' from news_events, two different scales in one field
type_warnings.inconsistency_note: intent_hiring_demand.category_breakdown DOES parse a JSON-array column, while tech_detections_reference.department_onet_codes does not. Same style of source column, two different treatments.

absent_vs_null.description: These keys are OMITTED entirely rather than set to null. Consumers must check for presence, not for null.
keys: news_signals_feed.data.signals[].location / product / amount — only on news_events rows
absent_vs_null.structural_note: google_news and news_events rows produce STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT signal dicts — location, product and amount exist only on news_events rows.

provenance_block.description: Both intent widgets always carry this block in data, in every branch including 'empty', so a screen can state where a number came from.

provider.name: Bombora
provider.note: A module constant — the CSV names no provider, so it is recorded once in code.

account_match.note: human sentence; null on a clean match
account_match.provider_topic_count: from intent_topics.Topic Count, kept as a STRING

observation.date_stamp: raw YYYYMMDD from intent_topics.Date Stamp; null if the export carries more than one distinct stamp
observation.note: one of three sentences: single stamp / N stamps / no stamp
observation.refreshed_at: from the file upload metadata, NOT from the CSV

shape.dictionary_version: intent-map-v1 — bump when the topic dictionary changes

solution_narratives_count.note: read from the owning widget; ABSENT when that feature has not run, and the card shows a dash

example.business_description: PT Astra International Tbk is a diversified conglomerate...

employee_count.note: a BAND, passed through verbatim; 'N/A' when blank

revenue.note: a BAND, passed through verbatim; 'N/A' when blank

open_job_count.warning: Despite the name this IGNORES the status column and counts every row. See intent_hiring_demand.open_postings for the status-filtered figure.

availability_states.available: topics present and the domain matched
availability_states.no_intent_data: no Bombora topics on file for this account
availability_states.no_matched_signal: topics exist but intent_topics.Company Website did not match the account domain — topics are then emptied

message.note: present only when availability is not 'available'

included.derived: false when the score is not a number

exclusion_reason.example: Composite Score 'n/a' is not a number

hiring_linked.derived: topic text contains a staffing term

matched_terms.note: which dictionary terms matched — why the topic landed where it did

flag_triggers: a near-miss word with no dictionary term
a hardware term next to software/advertising/marketing/media
more than one HP category named

intent_category_summary.role: Where the hp_category_intent file lands. Every score here is the provider's, as received — Python never invents one.
intent_category_summary.empty_when: Source A is unavailable AND category_file.status is not 'matched'. Even then, data still carries provenance and the full category_file so the screen can explain why.

source_a_status.note: null when Bombora topics are available; otherwise the {availability, message} pair

category_file.note: The per-category entries are NOT here — they live under hp_categories[].primary.

triggers.unverified: the account has no domain to check against
triggers.mismatch: no row for this account's domain

source.runs_on_file: count of rows matching this domain — the latest Run Date wins
source.refreshed_at: from upload metadata, not the CSV

top_check.recomputed_category: max over the parsed per-category scores
top_check.consistent: boolean — both equal after alias mapping

hp_play.note: a static reference label, not evidence

primary.note: One category block from the uploaded file, mapped field by field.
primary.provider_category: the row-1 group name, e.g. '3D Printers'
primary.has_signal: DERIVED: score is truthy AND stage is not '' or 'no signal'
primary.trend_label: from Intent Trend — the file's own words
primary.trend_basis: fixed sentence explaining that no prior window exists to verify a direction
primary.quality_flags: DERIVED: one {term, field, reason} per noisy term found in topics_researched or keywords_matched

supporting_signals.note: Bombora topics grouped by signal family, each with the account technologies that confirm it.
supporting_signals.max: highest composite_score in the family, or null
supporting_signals.technologies: [{name, sheet, column}] — where the technology was found
supporting_signals.confirmed: DERIVED: true only when there is BOTH research and matching installed technology

bombora_mapped.note: stats over topics whose hp_category is this category

explanation.note: composed by Python, never by a model

hp_category_total.note: a fixed taxonomy, not a discovered count

hiring_linked.note: stats over included topics whose text contains a staffing term

value.reason: A trend needs a prior window with the same scoring definition. Only the current export is on file.

stats_object_shape.note: The reusable stats shape used by themes, bombora_mapped and hiring_linked.
stats_object_shape.score_sum: number — kept so average is re-derivable by hand
stats_object_shape.intensity: band of the MAX, not the average

postings_seen.derived: len(all rows) — the same figure the Executive Dashboard shows

open_postings.derived: rows whose status is blank, 'open' or 'active'

open_postings_rule.note: the rule is published in the payload so the screen can state it

status_breakdown.note: Counter over status, lower-cased; blank becomes the key 'unspecified'

category_breakdown.note: The categories JSON array is parsed and EACH element counted separately, so these counts sum to MORE than the row count. Unparseable cells become one key from the whole raw string. Capped at the top 10.

first_seen.note: min of first_seen_at, truncated to 10 chars (date only)

last_seen.note: max of last_seen_at, truncated to 10 chars

tech_stack_matrix.empty_when: both the full stack list and the category matrix are empty

category_matrix.note: Key is the EXACT CSV column name, Title Case with spaces — 'It Security', 'Prog Langs And Frameworks', 'Bi And Analytics'. Blank columns are omitted entirely. The 'Technology' and 'Full Tech Stack' columns are excluded from the matrix.

tech_stack_matrix.data_team_caveat: A '(+7 more)' truncation suffix in a source cell is carried through verbatim as a list element.

webstack_breakdown.empty_when: the tech list, premium count and spend are ALL blank — note that categories_list alone does not make it available

web_spend_estimate.note: RAW STRING with no currency or unit attached — e.g. '5709'

categories_list.note: values keep their source underscores, e.g. 'Web_Server'

tech_detections_reference.empty_when: no row has an id or a score

score.note: RAW STRING on a 0-1 scale, never parsed

department_onet_codes.note: JSON array kept as a string, never parsed

tech_detections_reference.known_gap: No technology/vendor name is available, so a detection cannot be labelled on screen.

stakeholder_contacts_grid.note: No contact row is ever dropped. Every contact is scored.

source_breakdown.note: ALWAYS has both keys, zero-filled. 'Apollo' when apollo_requested_contact or apollo_matched_contact is non-blank, else 'Source A'.

department_distribution.note: Counter over the RAW Prospect job_department_main (not the normalized label); blank becomes 'Unassigned'

score_weights.note: echoed at top level and on every contact, so a score can be re-derived by hand

contact_id.note: from Prospect prospect_id, else positional contact_N

seniority_band.note: 'Individual Contributor' when the value is not in the enum

score_weights.note: the weights are published alongside the score

news_signals_feed.note: Both news files are normalized into one signal list, then gated, de-duplicated and scored.

total_signals_count.note: after gate, dedup, publish-threshold and cap. This is what exec_summary_card.recent_signals_count reads.

raw_signal_count.note: google_news + news_events rows that yielded a headline

gate_rejection_summary.note: THE most useful field for diagnosing a delivery — it says exactly why rows were dropped.

gate_rejections.note: every rejected signal in full, each with gate_reject_reason. Read this to see what was discarded.

signal_id.derived: sha1 of the canonical headline, first 12 chars

category.derived: mapped from event_type / category; unmatched becomes 'Strategic'

evidence_sentence.note: blanked when it equals the headline

source_url.note: empty string for news_events rows — never fabricated

gates.note: Rows are dropped before any scoring, each with a stored reason surfaced in gate_rejections and gate_rejection_summary.
gates.how_to_use: Compare raw_signal_count with total_signals_count. A large gate_rejected_count dominated by 'older than 365 days' means the delivery was mostly outside the window; dominated by 'unparseable date' means a date-format problem.

scoring.owner: Python — the model is never asked for the composite

remaining_widgets.note: The 31-widget registry also contains the following. They use the same envelope and read the same uploaded columns already documented above, so no new input requirement comes from them. Ask if you need a specific one expanded.
executive_dashboard: exec_urgency_score (derived — weights fixed, raw-data-to-driver formula deliberately undefined, so no score is computed)
recent_news_signals: news_relevance_summary (inferred — the LLM D1-D5 dimension scores behind news_signals_feed.confidence)
stakeholder_map: stakeholder_influence_map (derived — department groups, buying_group_coverage, ranked entry path; all computed from the contacts grid, no new column)
tech_landscape: technographic_map (deterministic — 7 fixed HP categories with vendor/whitespace rows; note hp_mapped_categories etc. are RATIO STRINGS like '5/7')

feature_dependencies.note: A feature produces NOTHING AT ALL if any listed dataset is registered but its file is unreadable. Stored widgets are left untouched rather than overwritten with empty data.
feature_dependencies.minimum_viable_note: compliance_filings additionally unlocks reported financial figures on the Executive Dashboard.

edge_cases.title: Wrong headers upload successfully
edge_cases.detail: No column validation exists. A file with entirely wrong headers returns HTTP 201 and then produces empty widgets.
edge_cases.detection: Check the upload response: regenerated should name the features that re-ran. Then fetch the widget and confirm status is 'available', not 'empty'.
edge_cases.mitigation: Diff your header row against this contract before upload.

edge_cases.title: Domain mismatch silently voids the whole intent feature
edge_cases.detail: firmographics.Company Domain, intent_topics.Company Website and hp_category_intent.Domain must all normalize to the identical bare host. A mismatch in any of them discards that file's contribution entirely.
edge_cases.detection: intent widgets report availability 'no_matched_signal' or status 'mismatch' rather than an error.
edge_cases.mitigation: Normalize the domain once upstream and reuse that exact value in every file.

edge_cases.title: Blank job_openings.status counts as open
edge_cases.detail: OPEN_STATUSES includes the empty string, so 40% of the reference file counts as open postings because the field is blank.
edge_cases.mitigation: Emit 'open' or 'closed' explicitly on every row. Open question 5.1.

edge_cases.title: Non-ISO dates sort wrong instead of failing
edge_cases.detail: job_openings.first_seen_at / last_seen_at are sorted as strings. A DD/MM/YYYY value produces wrong first/last dates with no error.

edge_cases.title: Day/month ambiguity in news dates
edge_cases.detail: DD/MM/YYYY is tried BEFORE MM/DD/YYYY, so 03/04/2025 is read as 4 March, not 3 April. The 365-day gate may then silently drop the signal.

edge_cases.title: News older than 12 months is discarded after upload
edge_cases.detail: The 365-day gate drops older signals once the file has been accepted.
edge_cases.mitigation: Confirm the intended window before building any historical back-fill — as it stands that work would be discarded. Open question 5.9.

edge_cases.title: Excel re-saves corrupt phone numbers and long IDs
edge_cases.detail: Opening a CSV in Excel coerces a phone number to a float, giving a trailing .0, and can convert long numeric ids to scientific notation. The phone normalizer strips a trailing .0 but nothing repairs scientific notation.
edge_cases.mitigation: Keep phone, id and code columns formatted as TEXT, or export straight from the source system without an Excel round-trip.

edge_cases.title: Extra rows in single-row files are ignored
edge_cases.detail: firmographics, company_hierarchy, technographics and webstack read row 0 only. A file holding several accounts silently reports only the first.

edge_cases.title: A comma-joined list where JSON is expected becomes one bogus value
edge_cases.detail: job_openings.categories falls back to using the whole raw cell as a single lower-cased category when JSON parsing fails.
edge_cases.mitigation: Emit valid JSON arrays with double quotes.

edge_cases.title: Provider truncation markers become technology names
edge_cases.detail: technographics cells ending in '(+15 more)' are ingested literally. Nothing strips them.

edge_cases.title: Duplicate intent topics are dropped, not averaged
edge_cases.detail: The first row wins on a case-insensitive match; the repeat is reported in duplicates_removed.
edge_cases.mitigation: De-duplicate upstream so the kept score is the one you intend.

edge_cases.title: A scanned PDF yields no financial figures
edge_cases.detail: Pages with no text layer are dropped, and a page stating no unit yields zero monetary claims even when its numbers are perfectly legible to a human.
edge_cases.mitigation: Digitally generated PDFs, with the unit sentence on every page of tables.

edge_cases.title: Two different job counts from one file
edge_cases.detail: exec_hiring_velocity.open_job_count counts every row despite its name; intent_hiring_demand.open_postings applies the status filter. They will not match, and this is deliberate.
edge_cases.mitigation: None needed on your side — raised so the discrepancy is not reported as a data bug.

edge_cases.title: Stored filename mangling on multi-file uploads
edge_cases.detail: The filename sanitizer's character class read [^a border-zA-Z0-9_.-]. The stray 'border-' parsed as the literals a/space/b/o/r/d/e plus the range r-z, so the twelve lowercase letters outside that range (c f g h i j k l m n p q) were each replaced with an underscore while spaces were let through: 'My Report 2026.csv' was stored as 'My Re_ort 2026._sv'.
edge_cases.scope: Stored filename only, and only for the four multi-file datasets. Single-file datasets use a canonical filename and never called it. The extension is appended separately by the caller and original_filename is kept in metadata, so no file became unreadable.
edge_cases.mitigation: None needed on your side, and nothing needs re-uploading.
edge_cases.our_action: Fixed: the class is now [^a-zA-Z0-9_.-]. Covered by tests/test_sanitize_filename.py. No mangled filenames existed on disk, so no migration was required.

edge_cases.title: Inferred widgets show 'pending' without an API key
edge_cases.detail: The LLM-backed widgets (news_relevance_summary, stakeholder_talking_points and the other 'inferred' ones) write status 'pending' with a notice when OPENAI_API_KEY is absent. Content is never invented. In that state news signals are still published, just unscored, so confidence and tier are null.
edge_cases.mitigation: None on your side — raised so a 'pending' widget is not reported as a data problem.

edge_cases.title: updated_at is not a change timestamp
edge_cases.detail: Every widget write sets updated_at equal to extracted_at from a single clock read, so the field changes on every extraction whether or not the content differed.
edge_cases.mitigation: Do not use updated_at to detect real change. Compare the payload itself.

edge_cases.title: A registered file missing from the server is not the same as no file
edge_cases.detail: Only metadata lives in the database; the bytes live on disk. If a record exists but the file does not, the extractor aborts and leaves the stored widgets untouched rather than publishing empty ones.
edge_cases.mitigation: None on your side — raised so a 'nothing changed' result is understood as protective rather than a failed upload.
